policy: Exploratory follow-up motivated by previously inspected test curves. Preserve original results. Reuse the same frozen CNN, features, splits and width-32 base checkpoints. Extend the original method and separately compare a signed parent refit accepting positive margins below one. New base tasks use the original 200-epoch schedule and optimizer. Repeat fixed depths with two fresh correction-network seeds. Never use validation/test metrics to fit, grow, stop or select models. Saturated repeated checkpoints do not count as extra capacity.
